# telegram-bot-ui

> Designs, audits, builds and operates everything a Telegram bot shows, sends and reacts to, with offline catalogs of the Bot API and Telegram.WebApp. Use when a request concerns a Telegram bot's or channel's messages, wording, buttons, keyboards, menus, navigation, forms, streaming AI replies, HTML widgets, Mini Apps, Rich Messages, premium emoji, emoji packs from video, formatting errors, Stars payments, webhooks, channel posts or mailings, a bot an agent uses to notify or ask for approval, a whole bot product, the bot-ui/ screen map or a Studio task, or whether the Bot API supports something, including the server side of these. Use it even for vague asks like 'make my bot nicer' or a pasted handler or payload. Do not use for other messengers, userbots, Telegram Ads, server setup (nginx, TLS, hosting), or CI, databases and auth no Telegram feature depends on, or Microsoft .rtf files.

An Agent Skill for Telegram bot interfaces, version 3.3.0, Bot API 10.5 (verified 2026-11-22). Start with the agent page; install it into your host, then use it in plain words.

## Docs

- [For agents](https://telegram-bot-ui.hlixli.com/agents.md): install per host, verify, commands, project memory, safety
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/hlibsuslov/telegram-bot-ui/blob/main/skills/telegram-bot-ui/SKILL.md): the skill's entry point
- [Everything in one file](https://telegram-bot-ui.hlixli.com/llms-full.txt): router, floor and every command playbook
